description: benchreceipt.result/v1 — verification result (PROJECT_BOOK §5.6, §12.2/§12.3). Frozen by P027-T002. Status vocabulary follows §5.6 including INTERNAL_ERROR. The reason-code vocabulary itself is NOT frozen as an enum in v1; T008 owns it (see ADR-001).

duplicate_jobs.description: Job ids seen more than once in the bundle.

expected_source_mode.description: Echo of the policy source_mode (PROJECT_BOOK §12.3 sample C).

identity_mismatches.description: Per-job identity field mismatches (source SHA, run id, attempt, tree, workflow). expected/actual are strings, integers, booleans, or null when not applicable.

field.description: Receipt field that mismatched, e.g. git.head_sha, ci.run_id, ci.run_attempt, git.tree_sha.

jobs_verified.description: Number of jobs that passed all identity and report checks.

missing_jobs.description: Required jobs absent from the bundle (PROJECT_BOOK §5.2).

reason_codes.description: Machine-readable reason codes, e.g. SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH, RUN_ATTEMPT_MISMATCH. Vocabulary owned by T008; only the SHAPE (uppercase snake-case tokens) is frozen here.

path.description: Relative report path inside the bundle, if known.

status.description: Four-state outcome plus INTERNAL_ERROR, per PROJECT_BOOK §5.6. Missing evidence, parse failure, unreadable input, or unknown fields must be UNBOUND or INVALID, never PASS.

unexpected_jobs.description: Jobs present in the bundle but not in required_jobs (PROJECT_BOOK §5.2).

title: benchreceipt.result/v1
